name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Welder goes with exactly two of Edison, Robotics, and Reactor.

Exactly one of these is true: Diesel goes with Robotics; Edison goes with Chemical; Otis goes with Welder.

Bell, Aerospace, Bridge, and Drill belong to different engineers.
Satellite does not go with Oscilloscope if and only if Reactor goes with Welder.
